title: Bakken sweep Naestved to repeat as Ligaen champions
description: Naestved - Bakken 86-88 Bakken Bears extended their Ligaen dominance. They swept Naestved to conquer the 8th straight title. The guests trailed by 9 points after three quarters before their 25-14 charge, which allowed them to win the game. Bakken made 16-of-20 free shots (80.0 percent) during the game. American guard Malik Parsons (190-1999, college: NWOSU) fired 21 points, 5 rebounds and 6 assists for the winners. The other American import forward DeAndre Pinckney (203-2000, college: Southern Miss) chipped in 22 points and 6 rebounds. Dutch forward Lagio Grantsaan (203-1997, college: Morgan St.) produced a double-double by scoring 15 points and 10 rebounds and American forward Gus Okafor (201-1999, college: Wichita St.) added 21 points respectively for lost side. Four Bakken and five Naestved players scored in double figures.
